title: simplicio.video-contract/v1
description: Video contract: everything the simplicio-video CLI needs to render one video deterministically. The LLM reasons and writes this file; the CLI executes it. Scene-relative times (fala.inicio_s, sfx.t) are seconds from the scene start.

drive_nome.description: Title_Case with underscores, no accents (e.g. Clinica_Sorriso)

coleta.description: path (relative to the contract) of the client's coleta/ folder, source of every fact

template.description: templates/<id> in the repo, or a path (relative to the contract) to a template dir with template.json + composition/

paleta.description: named brand colors (informational + available to the template)

logo.description: null = no logo file (text lockup); never recreate a logo

dagua.description: marca d'água da prévia (render --preview); padrão neutro 'Prévia'

credito.description: crédito final da prévia (cartão final); null = sem cartão final

assets.description: extra client files copied into the composition (photos, logo variants)

variaveis.description: raw HyperFrames variables merged after the scene textos (e.g. asset paths, colors the template declares)

placas_video.description: optional full-bleed video plates (engine clips); missing file => black stand-in + <id>_on=false. A plate never carries the openverse block: a file from the Openverse library (assets/openverse/ or the same bytes) is refused here, declare it in assets[] with the block

papel.description: role from the template (gancho, promessa, marca, cta...)

bloco.description: instance id used by the template ({{vars:<bloco>}})

tela.description: on-screen copy as read by a human (documentation only)

voice.description: voice name for the active provider (e.g. pf_dora for local/kokoro, Sulafat for gemini)

processamento.description: ffmpeg filter chain applied after silence trim

ducking.description: ducking em duas bandas sob a voz, só na trilha de arquivo (trilha.music.arquivo): graves abaixo de 250 Hz e agudos acima de 2.5 kHz baixam só nas janelas de voz; o meio não muda. duck_music_db e duck_sfx_db continuam como antes

graves_db.description: ganho dos graves (< 250 Hz) durante a voz, em dB

agudos_db.description: ganho dos agudos (> 2.5 kHz) durante a voz, em dB

jcut_max_s.description: how far a line may run past its scene end (J-cut)

api.description: Gemini Interactions API (default) or generateContent with responseModalities AUDIO

control.description: voice-design / style description, e.g. 'Young female voice, warm and gentle'

reference_audio.description: clean clip of an authorized speaker (relative to the contract); enables cloning
clean 10-30 s clip of an authorized speaker (relative to the contract)
clean clip of an authorized speaker (relative to the contract); enables cloning

device.description: auto, cpu, cuda or cuda:N (empty = the CLI default)

music.description: trilha: sem arquivo, a síntese do build.mjs (style, progression, sections, melody...); com arquivo, a trilha de arquivo (arquivo + cortes arranjados com crossfade; voz.ducking aplica o ducking em duas bandas)

arquivo.description: trilha de arquivo, relative to the contract (WAV/MP3/FLAC...): substitui a síntese

crossfade_ms.description: crossfade entre os trechos de cortes (ms); 0 = emenda seca

cortes.description: trechos da fonte na ordem da trilha: de_s/ate_s na fonte, em_s = posição de entrada na trilha de saída (já descontado o crossfade; o primeiro é 0)

arquivo.description: output path relative to the contract (gitignored out/)

qualidade.description: perfil de saída (src/simplicio_video/perfis.py): master = H.264 CRF 16, BT.709, AAC 320k, +faststart; lite = H.264 maxrate 10 Mbps, AAC 192k; thumb = só o PNG do quadro 0, sem MP4

preview.description: optional 720p preview path relative to the contract

arquivo.description: source path relative to the contract

openverse.description: optional provenance of an image or audio asset that comes from the Openverse library (simplicio-video openverse). The file must be the one `openverse library export <id> --pedido ... --contrato <contrato>` copied to assets/openverse/, next to its CREDITS-openverse.md. validate and render refuse it offline unless the id is in the library, the file has the library's sha256, the verdict for the exact pair (id, sha256, pedido, provenance) is approved, a restricted license was accepted at the export (--aceito-restricao) and the credit line is in CREDITS-openverse.md. A file inside assets/openverse/ without this block is refused. The render records the provenance in render.manifest.json and writes the credits next to the output MP4. The audio engine does not mix an audio asset by itself: only a template or block that references the file plays it.

id.description: Openverse id (UUID) of the asset in the local library

pedido.description: what the scene needs from this asset; compared normalized (no accents, lower case, no punctuation) with the request the asset was approved for

max_s.description: slot length; longer take = error (never speed up)

marcas.description: optional word marks (seconds from line start)
